tagline.en_US: IntelliJ IDEA helps you write code faster with tools that eliminate tedious tasks and let you focus on what matters – building great software.

description.en_US: IntelliJ IDEA is an integrated development environment designed to accelerate software engineering. It provides automated tools to eliminate repetitive development tasks, helping developers focus directly on building software.

tips: By default, there is no authentication enabled.
Copy and paste between your computer and the streamed desktop, including images, works over HTTPS: port 3001 or an HTTPS reverse proxy. Browsers block clipboard access over plain HTTP.
